_how_to: One entry per object, read off contact_selection/figures/annotation_guide.png, then rerun `.venv/bin/python -m contact_selection annotate` to check it.
Frame (cm, fixed per object): origin at the default robot-side tipping edge, x away from the robot, y to the robot's left.
x_cm, y_cm: the press contact. Press height is the top surface there. null = no pick yet.
tipping_edge_cm: [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]] on the support footprint (dashed outline). null = the default edge (x = 0).
pull_direction: null = toward the robot [-1, 0]; [dx, dy] = that horizontal direction; "through_com" = along the line from the 2D CoM through the contact, toward the tipping side.

heart.note: The default edge is a poor choice for the heart; pick an edge from the footprint.
